regression_measured_on_simulated.note: slope 1 = neighbour shift fully present in the residuals; 0 = not detectable at this noise

detectability.method: Illustrative 5-sigma (2-D) displacement thresholds from a reference-star error-budget model. Not a validated target-detection, completeness or false-positive measurement. Per axis and epoch: target centroid sigma_c = k * sqrt(chi2(S/N_f)) / S/N_f px (k = median sigma_px * S/N of the real references; chi2 from the formal-S/N bins of the same detector group), plus either (A, archive WCS as is) the empirical frame-to-frame scatter of the frame offsets, or (B, differential against the frame's references - would need a correction this build does not apply) the random part of the frame tie and the PSF-mismatch term; plus the star-to-star extra scatter and the median simulated neighbour shift. Epochs are independent; n frames per season average every per-frame term down by sqrt(n) (shared-all-frame terms are ~1e-5" and ignored). Threshold: |d| >= sqrt(chi2_2^-1(1 - 5.7e-7)) sigma_d, sigma_d = sqrt(2) sigma_epoch / sqrt(n).

sky_fixed_structure.method: Is the pixel structure that VARIANCE does not describe fixed on the sky? High-pass images (pixel minus 5x5 median, over sqrt(VARIANCE)) with Gaia G < 18.5 stars masked, correlated between frames of the same compatibility group at the same sky positions (bilinear). White noise gives rho = 0; faint sources / background give rho > 0.

stress_matrix.renderer: analytic Moffat (FWHM 1.15 px, beta 3) integrated over each native pixel (9x9 midpoint sub-samples); fitting model: an A&K ePSF built from the nominal PSF on the 5x grid, evaluated by the pipeline

cases.case: background gradient 2% of peak per px
background curvature 1% of peak at r=3 px
neighbour 100% at 2.05 px (allowed by the 2 px / 10 % rule)
neighbour 9% at 1.0 px (allowed by the rule)
neighbour 9% at 1.5 px (allowed by the rule)

detector_frame_offsets.interpretation: Frame offsets mapped to detector pixels. A common detector-x offset is consistent with an estimator or centroid-convention effect, but detector-linked archive-WCS calibration can also contribute; the origin is not uniquely identified. Its size is compared with the Gaia-free centroid-convention term; it is reported, not removed.
